Resolves #21535

`button.Base` now holds one menu list per button, built from its latest `menu`. A `menu` change made while the list module was still loading started a second build. The two imports can settle in either order, and `toggleMenu()` opened whatever list existed when the build it awaited settled. The tab overflow plugin makes exactly that change right after it creates its floating control, so the news bar showed the newer split while the open menu listed the older one, and `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` counted the boundary tab twice. Now an import that settles after a newer change builds nothing, a new list destroys the one it replaces, and `toggleMenu()` waits for the latest build.

Evidence: L3 (the real Portal in local Chromium under a delay-injection probe: 12 of 400 runs failed on `dev`, 0 of 400 at `b5d759c860`) → L3 required (AC-3).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs`, "a menu change while its list loads builds one list from the latest menu, and a click meanwhile shows it (#21535)" and "a later menu replaces the list it built before instead of orphaning it (#21535)". Both fail on `dev`: two lists get built, and the earlier list is never destroyed. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` is not touched by this diff. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: the delay-injection probe, 400 runs at the PR head without a failure (12 of 400 on `dev`). See Test Evidence. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The ticket's first candidate, the plugin's measure window, cannot occur on the Portal. Its body was corrected to the `button.Base` race before this PR, and AC-4 was struck, since no ticket would own it after the merge and AC-3 replaces it.
- A button destroyed while its list module loads no longer builds a list.
- No consumer code to delete: no consumer worked around the race.

Prescription checked: `src/button/Base.mjs` owns the concern, the lifecycle of the `menu` config's list. The plugin is one of three runtime `menu` writers, beside `desktop.Taskbar` and `button.Split`.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

Out of scope, noted in defect-notes: `button.Effect` and `functional/button/Base` build their lists the same way, and the floating overflow control observes its menu list late.

## Test Evidence

The instrument, local and not committed: random 0–250 ms delays before the two `getLayoutRect()` calls in `Overflow#project()` and before the `import('../menu/List.mjs')` in `afterSetMenu()` (one shared delay per App worker). It repeats `NewsTabOverflow`'s 390×664 and 320×568 steps with 6 workers on `test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs` and dumps the DOM when the bar and the open menu disagree.

- `dev` at `4c3e2dc343`: 12 of 400 failed, 7 of 200 and then 5 of 200 with event logs from inside the plugin. Each of the four failure dumps I read shows `Blog` counted twice, as in CI runs 44077921709 and 44242798291. The three logged failures show two `menu.List` builds after the split moved by one tab, with the open list holding the older records.
- PR head `b5d759c860`, same injection: 400 of 400 passed.
- Without injection, 120 local runs with the page's main thread throttled 4× also passed on `dev`, so the local repro needs the injected delay.

Unit, at the head: `test/playwright/unit/button/`, `tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs`, `desktop/` and `grid/SearchToolbar.spec.mjs`, 195 passed.

Responding to https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21538#pullrequestreview-5985738634. Both are right, Euclid, and the second was a regression this PR introduced: Taskbar's start menu passes `store: appStore`.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** **RA-1:** Treat `menu = null` as the latest configuration. Invalidate any pending build, destroy the list already owned by the button, and let a waiting toggle settle without opening a list or throwing when the menu has cleared. Add regressions for clearing during a pending click and clearing an open menu. Preserve normal non-null replacement and button destruction.
      **Commit:** `b48795500f`
      **Details:** A cleared menu sets `menuListReady` to `null`, so a build in flight finds a newer state and lands nothing, and it destroys the list the button holds. `toggleMenu()` returns once the latest `menuListReady` is `null`. Arms: "a menu cleared while its list loads builds nothing, and a click waiting on it settles without opening one (#21535)" and "clearing the menu takes an open list with it (#21535)". The replacement and destruction arms are unchanged and green.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** **RA-2:** Retire a superseded list without destroying a store passed to the replacement. Add a regression that configures a populated flat store, updates the menu configuration with the same store, and verifies the first list is retired and the replacement retains usable records. Keep the final list's existing store-ownership behavior.
      **Commit:** `b48795500f`
      **Details:** The replacement is built first. A retired list whose store is the replacement's gets `autoDestroyStore = false` before it is destroyed, so only the list goes; the final list keeps `autoDestroyStore` as it was. Arm: "a replacement menu over the same store retires the first list and keeps the store (#21535)".

All three new arms fail against `b5d759c860`'s source (3 failed) and pass at `b48795500f`. Unit, at the head: `test/playwright/unit/button/`, `tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs`, `desktop/` and `grid/SearchToolbar.spec.mjs`, 198 passed.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

- **Expected Solution Shape:** The button should own one live list for its current configuration. Superseded work must settle without opening another list. Controls should cover a newer configuration during the lazy load and the lifetime of the old list.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge**: The declared `menu` domain includes `null`. On the exact head, I started a toggle while the list import was pending, set `menu = null`, and awaited the toggle. It built and opened the cleared menu. Clearing an already-open menu also kept the same visible list alive.

**Findings:** [`afterSetMenu`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/b5d759c8609534628442b24acf9d9453a9f0ce33/src/button/Base.mjs#L360-L399) updates the generation only for truthy values. Removing readiness alone would leave a pending toggle trying to trap a null promise. [`toggleMenu`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/b5d759c8609534628442b24acf9d9453a9f0ce33/src/button/Base.mjs#L701-L718)

**Same-store replacement:** Open a menu configured with a populated flat `Neo.menu.Store`, then set `menu` again with that store and a different CSS class. At `a0db5d62cb` the new menu contains `Open`. At `b5d759c860`, the old list destroys the store before construction of its replacement. Readiness rejects and `menuList` still points at the destroyed list. The same head succeeds when both configs explicitly use `autoDestroyStore: false`. [`Button replacement`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/b5d759c8609534628442b24acf9d9453a9f0ce33/src/button/Base.mjs#L391-L397) · [`List store ownership`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/b5d759c8609534628442b24acf9d9453a9f0ce33/src/list/Base.mjs#L680-L687)
